_meta.purpose: Expected field-mapping content per real government form. The nightly seed/prod parity guard (scripts/check_seed_prod_parity.py) asserts PROD holds exactly this set of (field_kind, form_field_id) rows per form, failing on MISSING (a seed migration that never applied) or STALE (superseded rows a re-seed migration should have replaced) entries.
_meta.why: Form-fill seed migrations are merged to the repo but applied to prod out-of-band (no apply-on-merge; the applier is jammed). Three merged form-fill migrations silently never reached prod for months — FR served stale fictional field ids, ES had none — and nothing caught it: the fill tests use fixtures, the ledger isn't reconciled, and a row-COUNT check passes on stale data. This manifest is the source of truth the guard compares live prod against.
_meta.de_caveat: DE_blue_card_v2024's field ids are the current prod baseline; their correctness against a real DE AcroForm is separately UNVERIFIED. The guard checks presence/stability (that these rows exist and none silently change), not fidelity to a real PDF.
_meta.maintenance: When a form's field mappings change via a migration, update this manifest in the SAME PR so the nightly guard reflects the new intended state.
